hero.title: Help improve the List Builder
hero.description: This project is shaped by real players using it for real games. Whether you found a bug, noticed incorrect data, or have an idea that would make list building easier, your feedback helps decide what gets improved next.

bugs.title: Report bugs
bugs.description: Found something that does not work as expected? Share what happened, what you expected, and where you noticed the issue.

data.title: Improve data accuracy
data.description: Missing options, incorrect profiles, or outdated information can be reported here so the list builder becomes more reliable for everyone.

features.title: Suggest features
features.description: Have an idea that would make list building, roster management, or game preparation easier? Describe the problem you want solved.

general.title: Share general thoughts
general.description: Not every piece of feedback has to be a bug or feature request. If something feels confusing, slow, awkward, or useful, that matters too.

form.title: Send feedback
form.description: Try to include enough context to make the feedback easy to understand. For bug reports, the page, list, army, unit, or action you were using is especially helpful.
form.rulebookNotice: Please avoid copying full rulebook text. A short description of the issue, the affected unit or option, and the source you are comparing against is enough.

languageNotice.title: Please write your feedback in English.
languageNotice.description: This allows the development team to understand your message and respond when needed.

description.label: Description
description.placeholder: Describe what happened, what you expected, or what you would like to improve.

contactEmail.label: Contact email
contactEmail.placeholder: Optional, only needed if you want a reply

form.reviewNotice: Feedback is reviewed manually and helps prioritize future improvements.
